{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''Z-Pata group''' was a group of three [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] that belonged to the rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. They were part of a second attempt at capturing the ''[[Vorknkx]]'' at its first location after a previous attempt involving the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Z-Borus]]'' failed. However, despite support involving [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] and [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]], the cruisers were destroyed.
